name: 左文右圖＋圖片貼齊區塊上緣與畫面右緣
desc: 左欄一段文字（小標籤、大標題、大字標語、說明文字、按鈕），右欄一張直式大圖片佔畫面右半，貼齊區塊上緣與畫面右緣；文字欄比圖片低一段開始、也比圖片晚結束，兩欄上下錯開。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。左右兩欄各佔約一半：右側放一張直式大圖片，佔畫面寬約一半，向右延伸並貼齊畫面右緣，上方貼齊區塊上緣（區塊上方不留白），高度約為區塊的八成，下方不到區塊底部；左側是文字欄，靠左並對齊頁面內容寬度。文字欄不是垂直置中，而是從區塊上緣往下約兩成處開始，最後的按鈕落在圖片下緣之下，兩欄上下錯開。文字欄由上而下：大標題（可多行），標題下方是一段明顯比說明文字大、比大標題略小的大字（可多行），再下方是數段說明文字；大標題上方可放小標籤，最下方可放按鈕，沒有時省略。
mobile: 改為直向堆疊：圖片在上、文字欄在下。圖片維持直式（略高於寬，不做成方形），仍貼齊區塊上緣，左右兩側留邊、不再延伸到畫面邊緣；文字欄靠左，元素順序不變；取消兩欄上下錯開。

en.name: Text left, image right + image flush with the section top and the screen's right edge
en.desc: A left text column (label, headline, large statement, description, button) and a large portrait image taking the right half of the screen, flush with the section top and the screen's right edge; the text column starts lower and ends later than the image, so the two columns are staggered vertically.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. Two columns each take about half: the right column holds one large portrait image, about half the screen width, extending right to sit flush with the right edge of the screen and flush with the top edge of the section (no spacing above the section), about eighty percent of the section height, stopping short of the section bottom; the left column is a text column, aligned left to the page content width. The text column is not vertically centered; it starts about one fifth of the way down from the top of the section, and its final button sits below the bottom edge of the image, so the two columns are staggered vertically. From top to bottom the text column contains: a headline (may wrap to multiple lines); below it a large statement (may wrap to multiple lines), clearly larger than the description and slightly smaller than the headline; then several paragraphs of description. Optionally place a label above the headline and a button at the very bottom; omit them when there is no content.
en.tablet: The tablet layout follows the desktop layout.
en.mobile: Stack vertically: image on top, text column below. The image stays portrait (slightly taller than wide, not square), stays flush with the top edge of the section, and has a margin on the left and right instead of extending to the screen edge; the text column is aligned left with the same element order; the vertical stagger between the columns is removed.
